```{.r .cell-code}
so_full <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
so_T <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds"))
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
metadata_full_df <- as_tibble(so_full@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, general_cell_types)
metadata_T_df <- as_tibble(so_T@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, clusters_T, general_T_subtypes)
metadata_M_df <- as_tibble(so_M@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, clusters_M, general_M_subtypes)

metadata_df <- metadata_full_df %>%
    left_join(metadata_T_df, by = "cell") %>%
    left_join(metadata_M_df, by = "cell")

cluster_df <- metadata_df %>%
    mutate(subcluster = ifelse(
        is.na(clusters_T),
        as.character(clusters_M),
        as.character(clusters_T)
    )) %>%
    mutate(subcluster = case_when(
        general_cell_types == "Myeloid" & is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
        general_cell_types == "T/NK" & is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
        TRUE ~ subcluster
    ))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
doublets <- cluster_df %>% 
    filter(subcluster == "doublets") %>% 
    .$cell
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hto_df <- as_tibble(t(as.matrix(so_full@assays$HTO@data)), rownames = "cell")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
metadata_to_add <- cluster_df %>% 
    select(cell, subcluster) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so_full <- AddMetaData(so_full, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
plot_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_full) %>% 
    mutate(transcriptional_doublets = ifelse(subcluster == "doublets", 
                                             "myeloid/T\ndoublets", 
                                             "other\ncells")) %>% 
    mutate(transcriptional_doublets = ifelse(is.na(transcriptional_doublets), 
                                             "other\ncells", 
                                             transcriptional_doublets)) %>% 
    left_join(hto_df, by = "cell") 
plot_tidy <- plot_df %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "hashtag1", "hashtag2", "hashtag3")) 
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
plot_tidy %>% 
    filter(name %in% c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA")) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(transcriptional_doublets, value) + 
    geom_violin(scale = "width", draw_quantiles = 0.5) + 
    facet_wrap(name~sample, scale = "free_y", ncol = 7)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
plot_hashtags_for_sample <- function(sample_str, hashtags = c(1, 2)) {
    p1 <- plot_df %>% 
        filter(sample == sample_str) %>% 
        ggplot() + 
        aes(hashtag1, hashtag2) + 
        geom_density_2d(aes(color = transcriptional_doublets)) +
        labs(title = sample_str) + 
        theme(legend.position = "top", 
              legend.direction = "vertical")
    
    out <- p1
    
    if (3 %in% hashtags) {
        
        p2 <- plot_df %>% 
            filter(sample == sample_str) %>% 
            ggplot() + 
            aes(hashtag1, hashtag3) + 
            geom_density_2d(aes(color = transcriptional_doublets)) + 
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        
        p3 <- plot_df %>% 
            filter(sample == sample_str) %>% 
            ggplot() + 
            aes(hashtag2, hashtag3) + 
            geom_density_2d(aes(color = transcriptional_doublets)) + 
            theme(legend.position = "none")

        out <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3, align = "h")
    }
    
    return(out)
}
```
